title: SEIHRF-OD: Code, data, and figures for 'Political distrust, armed conflict, and body reclamation drive Ebola transmission dynamics in eastern DRC'
description: Reproducibility package for the SEIHRF-OD model paper, submitted for peer review (2026). Contains Stan/Python calibration code, INSP sitrep data (INRB-UMIE/BDBV2026-Data, formerly Ebola_DRC_2026), posterior draws calibrated on the early growth phase (5,713 confirmed cases, 104 days, data freeze 25 August 2026, build 1819da2), all publication figures, sensitivity analysis, hold-out validation, and posterior predictive checks. Version 3.1.0 adds a prospective validation of the 25 August posterior, without refitting, against data released afterwards (to 20 November 2026; build 5779270b, SitRep 190; 11,762 confirmed cases): observed incidence peaked in mid-August and plateaued, whereas the constant-parameter model forecast continued growth (median 3.18 million vs 6,050 observed cases, 26 Aug-20 Nov). The long-horizon peak-timing projection included in earlier versions is withdrawn and kept only for the record. The README documents which headline quantities were stable across data freezes and which were not.
